faq.heading: FAQ
faq.howReferralsWork: Share your invite link. Anyone who joins through it becomes one of your referrals.
faq.whatCounts: A referral counts once they've completed their profile, posted on two separate days and are in good standing.
faq.whyNotCountedYet: Most of the time they haven't posted on a second day yet. Open the referral to see exactly what's left.
faq.whenDoIEarn: You earn {{amount}} at {{target}} qualified referrals, and again for every {{target}} after that.
faq.canIEarnAgain: Yes. The {{amount}} reward repeats. The badge, Live Creator access and Early Supporter are one time only.
faq.howToUnlockLive: Live Creator eligibility unlocks with the {{target}}th qualified referral.
faq.canFamilyParticipate: Yes. Family, roommates, classmates and colleagues can all take part, including on the same network.
faq.underReview: A review means we're checking something automatically. It usually resolves on its own and you don't need to do anything.
faq.howRewardsBecomeAvailable: Rewards are earned right away and reviewed before they're released.
faq.isThereALimit: There's no cap on qualified referrals or on repeat rewards.
faq.whenDoesItEnd: The challenge ends at {{target}}, but your journey doesn't. New missions open up after that.
